title: Silky Potato and Leek Soup with Chives and Crispy Leeks
summary: Gently softened leeks and potatoes are simmered and blended into a velvety soup enriched with cream, then topped with crisp fried leek strips and chives.
equipment: large heavy-based pot with a lid

ingredients.item: medium leeks, white and pale green parts, halved, sliced and washed
fine sea salt or table salt
floury or all-purpose potatoes, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes
small leek, white part only, cut into thin 5 cm strips, washed and dried

steps.title: Sweat the leeks
steps.text: Melt the butter in the pot over medium-low heat, add the sliced leeks with a pinch of the salt and cook for 10 min, stirring often, until very soft but not browned. Add the garlic for 1 min. Low heat and salt draw out moisture slowly, keeping the leeks sweet and the soup pale.

steps.title: Simmer the potatoes
steps.text: Add the potatoes, broth, water, bay leaf, remaining salt and pepper. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer gently for 15-20 min until the potatoes break easily with a spoon. Remove the bay leaf.

steps.title: Blend until silky
steps.text: Blend the soup until smooth. With an upright blender, fill it no more than half full and hold the lid down with a towel, as hot liquid expands and can force the lid off. Avoid over-blending, which can turn potato starch gluey.

steps.title: Add the cream
steps.text: Stir in the cream and reheat until steaming and just bubbling, without a hard boil. Thin with a splash of water if it is very thick; gentle heat keeps the cream smooth.

steps.title: Crisp the leeks
steps.text: Heat the oil in the frying pan over medium heat and fry the leek strips for 3-5 min, stirring, until golden. Lift them onto kitchen paper with the slotted spoon. Dry strips crisp fast, so watch closely once they start colouring.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle the soup into bowls and top with the crispy leeks and chives just before serving, so the leeks stay crunchy.

tips: A common mistake is browning the leeks at the start; keep the heat low so the soup stays pale and sweet.
Wash the leeks well after slicing, since grit hides between the layers.
Dry the leek strips thoroughly before frying so they crisp rather than spit.
Blend just until smooth; overworking potatoes makes the soup gluey.
storage: Cool and refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Reheat until boiling hot (74°C), stirring often, and keep the crispy leeks separate in an airtight container.
